opening_thought: Stars through glass. Brass and silence. STILL is written everywhere — ultimate secret, name of the system. Or: the last still day before I disappeared inside.

thoughts.lesson_4_observatory: Still. The last lesson. The door will know when I carry it home. Stillpoint — instant life stopped moving, not just a padlock word.
thoughts.all_lessons_learned: Four lessons. Four worlds. Four places I hid from one person. The bedroom door waits for all of it.
thoughts.observatory_telescope_musings: Every star a pin in a map I forgot I made with her — shoulder against mine, no words, sky infinite.
thoughts.observatory_chart_musings: STILL circled on the chart. Delusion: final key. Memory: the last quiet night before the spiral.

observatory_clue_found.title: Star Chart Clue
observatory_clue_found.body: Constellations in gold ink. STILL circled until the paper wore thin — prefix of STILLPOINT, name of the trial, name of the last good day.

lesson_4_observatory.title: Lesson — Still
lesson_4_observatory.body: Brass chest opened to STILL. Bedroom door can hear you now. You mythologized a car roof until stars became locks.

observatory_telescope.title: Telescope
observatory_telescope.body: Brass tube aimed at a sky that shouldn't exist indoors. Lens clean as a held breath — the kind you took with her when talking would have broken the still.

observatory_chart.title: Star Chart
observatory_chart.body: STILL repeated, circled, underlined. Cosmology's last rung — or the word for the night you should have stayed present.

observatory_chest.title: Brass Chest
observatory_chest.body: Final lock in the four worlds. Wants STILL — the word the stars keep repeating, the word before POINT, the word before you left.

ending.title: Still
ending.body: The dome turns one last degree. STILL returns — lesson complete, memory named, door listening.
